added.description:
About The Company

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

About The Role

Flow is seeking a Director of Engineering
to oversee building operations, maintenance performance, and critical systems across a portfolio of multifamily communities.

This role serves as the operational leader for engineering teams within an assigned region, partnering closely with General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and onsite maintenance teams to ensure our communities operate safely, efficiently, and to Flow standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership experience across multiple properties. They are equally comfortable walking a mechanical room, reviewing a maintenance budget, analyzing operational metrics, and mentoring onsite teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Operations

Provide technical and operational support to engineering teams across multiple communities
Ensure consistent execution of preventative maintenance programs, work orders, unit turns, and repair and maintenance activities
Conduct regular property visits, inspections, and operational audits to verify compliance with company standards
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements that enhance service delivery and resident experience
Support General Managers and onsite leadership teams with engineering-related challenges and escalations

Engineering & Building Systems

Monitor the performance, maintenance, and uptime of critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevators, generators, access control, and fire & life safety systems
Lead troubleshooting efforts and support remediation of major maintenance-related issues
Ensure preventative maintenance schedules are executed and documented properly
Assist with planning and execution of deferred maintenance projects and system upgrades
Identify life safety, employee safety, and physical hazards and develop corrective action plans

Vendor & Contract Management

Manage relationships with service providers and contractors across the portfolio
Review vendor performance, scope of work, and contract compliance
Participate in bid processes and vendor selection efforts
Conduct regular business reviews with key service partners to ensure quality, responsiveness, and value
Recommend opportunities for contract optimization and cost savings

Financial Performance

Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning efforts
Monitor maintenance expenses, turnover costs, and service contract expenditures
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency while maintaining service standards
Assist with evaluating repair-versus-replace decisions and long-term asset planning

Compliance & Safety

Ensure properties operate in accordance with all federal, state, and local regulations
Maintain compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and applicable building and life safety codes
Support safety training initiatives and reinforce company safety standards
Ensure all required inspections, testing, certifications, and documentation are completed on schedule

Team Leadership

Coach, develop, and support onsite engineering teams and maintenance leaders
Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of engineering personnel
Assist with performance management and succession planning efforts
Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement

Reporting & Performance Metrics

Monitor and evaluate key operational metrics including preventative maintenance completion, work order completion times, unit turn performance, resident service feedback, compliance inspections, budget performance, and critical systems uptime
Provide regular reporting and recommendations to leadership teams

Ideal Background

5+ years of engineering, facilities, or maintenance leadership experience within multifamily, hospitality, commercial real estate, or a related industry
Experience overseeing operations across multiple properties or locations
Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, elevators, and fire & life safety systems
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations, EPA requirements, and NFPA codes
Experience managing third-party vendors and service contracts
Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and maintenance expenditures
Experience using Yardi or similar property management platforms
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned portfolio
Bilingual English and Spanish fluency highly preferred

Benefits

We take care of our people so they can do their best work.

Health and Wellness Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance and parental leave benefits. On-staff doctor, free therapy through SpringHealth, acupuncture, an Employee Assistance Program, and other wellness offerings.
Time Off PTO and paid holidays.
Financial 401(k) retirement plan, healthcare and dependent care FSAs, HSA-compatible plan options with annual employer HSA funding and pre-tax commuter benefits.
Life at Flow Weekly catered lunches, wellness classes and employee discounts on Flow hotel stays, grocer products, and merch.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Build an AI-Native Engineering Culture in West Palm Beach

Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Sr. Director, Platform Engineering & Tooling will be the senior leader responsible for shaping and scaling Prolaio’s cloud-native platform engineering capabilities that underpin its clinical, quality, research, and AI-driven data ecosystem. This role owns the foundational tooling (including observability, cloud infrastructure tooling, platform access, data access controls, and data lifecycle management), platform services, and shared engineering capabilities required to support secure, scalable, and governed access to data and platform resources across clinical trials, QMS workflows, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in a regulated healthcare environment. This role will ensure that core platform features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the platform. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing healthcare data platforms and AI-enabled platform features in a growth-stage company

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s platform engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud and data platform capabilities aligned to business, clinical, and AI priorities.
Build and evolve the core platform tooling needed for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cloud operations across GCP-based environments.
Own foundational platform capabilities for platform access, data access, identity-aware controls, service authorization, and secure environment provisioning.
Drive platform services and automation for data lifecycle management, including ingestion, validation, publishing, retention, archival, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness.
Partner with the Director of Data Engineering to strengthen Prolaio’s data architecture, API’s, data pipelines, and warehouse capabilities as part of the broader enterprise data platform.
Deliver reusable platform features and shared services that accelerate clinical research, analytics, data science, and data services teams.
Ensure platform features are designed with security, privacy, compliance, and HIPAA-aligned controls built in from the start, including support for regulated and validated environments.
Lead the development of AI-powered platform capabilities such as intelligent monitoring, workflow automation, metadata enrichment, and policy-aware access enablement.
Partner across Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, and Data teams to embed governance, operational controls, and regulatory readiness into the platform lifecycle.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing platform engineering team with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, and a mindset suited to a fast-moving growth-stage company.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms. Minimum 7 years of experience as Sr. Director/VP Engineering or Platform Engineering.
Demonstrated success as a senior engineering leader, including building, scaling, and coaching engineering teams while maintaining strong technical judgment and delivery accountability.
Proven experience designing, developing, and successfully delivering modern data platforms or platform engineering capabilities that support analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and enterprise data use cases.
Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platform engineering practices, including infrastructure automation, observability, access controls, API-first architectures, and scalable service design.
Strong software engineering experience using Python and at least one of Java or .NET, with familiarity building internal platform features, services, or developer tooling; experience with SQL is required. Experience with Angular or React is good to have.
Deep understanding of the capabilities needed to support clinical trials, QMS ecosystems, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in regulated healthcare settings.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation.
Experience implementing data lifecycle management, governed data access, metadata or lineage-aware architectures, and platform controls that support traceability, reproducibility, auditability, and privacy requirements.
Strong working knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA and regulated system practices such as 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP-aligned controls, as they apply to platform engineering and patient-data systems.
Ability to operate as a self-starter in a cross-functional, matrixed, growth-stage environment, partnering effectively with CIO leadership, Engineering, Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, Analytics and Data Science teams.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
Flexible Spending Perks:

Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.

Plan for the Future

Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Director/Sr. Director, Data Engineering will lead and scale Prolaio’s healthcare data engineering capabilities that power its clinical intelligence products, real-world data pipelines, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services in a regulated environment, building secure, reliable, and AI-enabled data platforms that transform continuous, predictive, and shareable heart data into faster therapeutic discovery and better cardiovascular outcomes while operating as a self-starter senior leader in a growth-stage company. This role will ensure that core data engineering features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the data engineering features. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing data engineering and AI-enabled data pipeline features in a growth-stage company.

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s enterprise data engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable data platform capabilities aligned to clinical, research, product, and AI priorities in regulated healthcare settings.
Architect and oversee end-to-end data flows and reusable pipelines for ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, publishing, retention, archival, and decommissioning across batch, streaming, and hybrid workloads.
Own the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and interoperable data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured clinical, operational, device, and patient-generated data relevant to Prolaio’s cardiovascular mission.
Define and enforce engineering standards for data modeling, lifecycle management, lineage, provenance, traceability, and auditability, embedding HIPAA, privacy, security, and GxP-aligned practices into day-to-day development workflows.
Partner closely with Data Architecture to design and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models, apply healthcare standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC), and deliver analysis-ready, interoperable datasets.
Build and evolve robust data engineering capabilities across modern cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure) and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse), including orchestration, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
Lead the development of AI-enabled data engineering features such as intelligent data quality monitoring, metadata enrichment, semantic search, feature generation workflows, and automation that accelerate analytics, data science, and clinical research teams.
Collaborate with Quality, Clinical Operations, Security, Product, and Engineering to embed validation, change management, governed data access, master data management, and release readiness into the data platform lifecycle.
Establish and manage high-performing data engineering teams, providing clear ownership, coaching, and execution discipline suited to a fast-moving growth-stage environment, while influencing architecture and implementation decisions across a matrixed organization.
Support vendor and tool evaluation, including build-versus-buy decisions for data integration, quality, metadata, lineage, interoperability, and AI-enabled data management capabilities.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms.
At least 7 years of experience as a Director or Sr. Director (or equivalent senior leadership role) leading data engineering or closely related data platform teams in growth-stage or innovation-driven organizations.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering healthcare data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, with proven success in regulated or validated environments.
Deep understanding of healthcare data domains (clinical trials, cardiovascular and physiological data, real-world data, claims, medication, socio-economic and behavioral data) and the application of healthcare terminologies and common data models (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC).
Proven experience designing and operating end-to-end data flows, scalable pipelines, lineage, provenance, traceability, and data lifecycle management that support product, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services use cases.
Strong familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, or comparable environments, including hands-on work with orchestration, APIs, and integration.
Strong software engineering and data engineering experience with Python and SQL and at least one of Java or .NET, with a track record of building internal data platform features, services, and developer tooling; experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular or React) is good to have. Experience in developing Agentic pipelines would be a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, matrixed organizations, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Security, with a self-starter mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a growth-stage environment.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation, and experience implementing governed data access and privacy-aware architectures.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of product vision, market intelligence, and technical architecture — helping define not just what Salesforce builds next, but why and how.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking product innovation agenda. You will lead and grow a team of product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner options, and translating complex technical and market dynamics into clear, executable product strategies.

This role goes well beyond traditional corporate strategy. We are not looking for someone who reacts to the latest headlines or incoming M&A signals. We are building a team that gets ahead of trends — a group that proactively surfaces what Salesforce might be missing, stress-tests assumptions, and shapes the decisions that will define our product platform for the next decade.

From guiding the productization of emerging internal capabilities — spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures — to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce is building the right things, at the right time, with the right model.

Lead product strategy for forward-looking innovation, whitespace identification, and productization planning across Salesforce's AI and platform portfolio.
Drive product strategy for emerging offerings moving from internal capability to standalone or platform-integrated product — including trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI systems, and data platforms.
Own and evolve a strategic framework for evaluating build-buy-partner decisions, including how and when to integrate acquired technologies into the core Salesforce platform versus taking them to market independently.
Proactively identify and assess game-changing market shifts — including the agentic coding revolution, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source commercialization trends — and translate these into actionable investment recommendations.
Partner closely with the SVP to define 'what are we missing' across the product portfolio, filling gaps in strategic coverage that go beyond what reactive competitive intelligence can provide.
Synthesize inputs from engineering, product management, research, M&A, and external sources to develop clear, evidence-based points of view on where Salesforce should place strategic bets.
Perform quantitative and competitive analytics to size market opportunities, assess competitive positioning, and support investment recommendations with data-driven evidence.
Partner with regional leadership to expand Salesforce's product strategy footprint into European markets, accounting for local regulatory requirements, competitive dynamics, and go-to-market nuances.
Evaluate productization models — open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first — and build decision-making frameworks that account for monetization, competitive dynamics, and developer adoption.
Monitor venture investment trends, startup ecosystem signals, and technical research to stay ahead of emerging paradigms before they become conventional wisdom.
Present strategic recommendations and options to the SVP and cross-functional executives in a clear, structured, and data-supported manner.
Build and mentor a high-performing strategy team, establishing processes for ongoing horizon scanning, opportunity assessment, and strategic synthesis.

You're Our Person If

12+ years of experience spanning product management, product strategy, technology strategy, or innovation roles — preferably at an enterprise software or cloud platform company.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams of 3 or more strategists, researchers, or product managers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Deep working knowledge of AI and machine learning architectures, including agentic systems, LLM-based applications, and AI integration patterns within enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of systems of record, data platforms, and enterprise application architectures, including how AI layers are introduced into or layered atop traditional SaaS infrastructure.
Fluency in evaluating productization strategies, including trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and standalone go-to-market models.
Experience participating in or supporting M&A strategy, including acquisition thesis development, integration planning, or build-buy-partner evaluation.
Ability to structure and communicate complex, multi-variable strategic analyses for senior executive audiences — in writing, in presentations, and in live discussions.
Comfort operating in contexts where the problem is not fully defined and the path forward requires both intellectual rigor and creative hypothesis generation.

Even Better If

Experience in product strategy or innovation roles at an AI-first company, an enterprise platform vendor, or a technology-focused management consulting firm.
Familiarity with agentic coding tools, developer platform ecosystems, and the competitive landscape around AI-assisted software development.
Knowledge of supply chain, operations, or vertical AI automation and process agentification at enterprise scale.
Track record of developing original investment or product theses — not simply synthesizing others' frameworks, but originating new points of view.
Exposure to venture capital, corporate development, or startup ecosystem dynamics, with the ability to translate investment signals into product strategy implications.
Builder's mindset: You are energized by creating new things — teams, frameworks, markets — not just running existing processes.
Experience working on both offensive (new market entry, new product launch) and defensive (competitive response, retention of strategic position) product strategies.
MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant discipline is a plus; demonstrated outcomes matter more than credentials
